# Verdant handoff pack — file map

> Every file in this pack gets one line below: its path, its size in bytes, what it is, and
> when to read it. Most tasks need two or three of them, not all of them.
>
> Generated by agent-layer/gen-pack-index.mjs from the pack directory itself, never written
> by hand. Sizes are measured at generation, so a line that disagrees with the file it names
> is drift and this repo's build gate fails on it by path.
>
> llms.txt is the one pack file with no line below, and the one file pack.bundle.json does
> not inline: the bundle carries every file it lists and this map measures the bundle, so each
> would depend on the other's byte count and no single generation pass could be right.
>
> Verdant is a fictional demo scenario. The components, tokens and contracts are real.

## Files
vocabulary.json · 55135 B · the agentic vocabulary: every component the renderer accepts, with its props, enums and children · read when composing a screen — a tree that does not validate against this is refused
pack.json · 116982 B · every ComponentSpec: the machine head, the engineer prose (purpose, states, accessibility) and the portability block · read when you want the prose behind a component, or the whole spec set as one object
contracts/care-task-row.contract.json · 1456 B · JSON Schema 2020-12 for the record care-task-row binds · read when binding real records to care-task-row
contracts/plant-card.contract.json · 1960 B · JSON Schema 2020-12 for the record plant-card binds · read when binding real records to plant-card
contracts/stat-tile.contract.json · 1249 B · JSON Schema 2020-12 for the record stat-tile binds · read when binding real records to stat-tile
contracts/status-chip.contract.json · 747 B · JSON Schema 2020-12 for the record status-chip binds · read when binding real records to status-chip
tokens/css/contract.css · 4171 B · every semantic token name with its neutral fallback, brand-free by construction · read when you need the CSS custom-property names the components read
tokens/css/neutral.css · 5194 B · the neutral pack: the values behind the contract, and the one layer a brand replaces · read when re-skinning — clone this file, never the contract
tokens.dtcg.json · 19303 B · the token source in DTCG format, the file both CSS layers are generated from · read when importing the tokens into Figma or Style Dictionary
tokens/ios/FactoryTokens.swift · 4753 B · the Style Dictionary iOS build of the same tokens · read when building these components on iOS
tokens/android/tokens.xml · 2932 B · the Style Dictionary Android build of the same tokens · read when building these components on Android
wc/README.md · 5372 B · how the custom-element wrappers are loaded, themed and demonstrated · read when you are about to drop the elements into a page
wc/vd-care-task-row.mjs · 5312 B · a standalone custom element wrapping care-task-row, themed by the token contract alone · read when you want care-task-row as an element instead of copy-paste markup
wc/vd-plant-card.mjs · 6487 B · a standalone custom element wrapping plant-card, themed by the token contract alone · read when you want plant-card as an element instead of copy-paste markup
wc/vd-status-chip.mjs · 2739 B · a standalone custom element wrapping status-chip, themed by the token contract alone · read when you want status-chip as an element instead of copy-paste markup
figma-import.md · 13877 B · the DTCG-to-Figma import path, written for the design-tool end · read when taking the tokens into a design tool
pack.bundle.json · 262791 B · every other file in this pack inlined into one JSON object, lossless UTF-8 · read when you want the whole pack in one fetch
